attribution.note: Ground-truth side rows written once per run (never by the subject). §4-2 (Michie 2026-09-29, after the Codex reviews of 7e9a3e2 and 5758e0a): columns A and B are decided by PEOPLE; the instrument only detects change. Every run it reads the three sources fixed here — A1 and A2 (the URLs above, raw HTTP body bytes after HTTP 200 and complete receipt) and B (the catalog item for service_id, body = the canonical text of the whole item made from the item's ORIGINAL TEXT by a strict RFC 8259 scanner — never from a parsed value, since a value round trip loses information (Codex 544808b R2); every number token as written — minus exactly two members, and only while the token as written has the grammar of a value that changes on its own: _meta.attempt_id while it is a lower-case RFC 4122 UUID in quotes, freshness.data_age_days while it matches ^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,4}|100000)$ — catalog.body_fields; any other token, e.g. a URL in attempt_id or 1e5 in data_age_days, stays in the body so the sha256 changes; a text outside the grammar, with a key twice in one object, deeper than 64 or over 1 MiB, or a tool result that is not exactly one text block has no body: B is unknown and no attestation is looked up) — and takes each body's sha256. A source's state comes only from a valid human attestation in evidence/attestations/<marker>-<source>-<body sha256>.json for that exact body. The fields that decide are bound to allowed values or computed values, never screened by forbidden words: exactly ten keys; attestation kansei-attribution-attestation/v2; verdict listed or not_listed; observer one of the strings in evidence/attestations/observers.json (character for character); date a real YYYY-MM-DD not after today; target equal to this taskpack's source (the URL for A1/A2, 'kansei-catalog <display_api_url> service_id=<service_id> fields=<body_fields>' for B); marker_id, expected_digest, source_id and body_sha256 equal. reason is a note that decides nothing (non-empty, at most 200 characters, no control character or line/paragraph separator; an unfinished-looking note only raises a private caution). Drafts carry no verdict. Without a valid attestation the source is 未確定（本文に変化あり・要再確認）, marked in the private sidecar and in the README rows. A = listed if a page is attested listed, not listed only if both pages are attested not listed; B = the attested verdict. The automatic reading of a body (attribution-rules.mjs) is written to the private sidecar as a hint only and never reaches a row, a judgement or the sheet. Row encoding: pass = listed; instrument_error 'other' = unknown; pass=false with instrument_error=null = not listed. Rename detection: the GitHub API full_name must equal the sealed owner/repo and archived must be false (15 s timeout; no answer = inconsistent), otherwise the day's judgement is 未確定（計器）. The judgement is a report-layer interpretation labelled 判断（規則 v0.1）.

marker.note: M-004 covers discover + understand only (connect + execute will be M-005). No contact with the vendor: the harness only asks public LLMs (one plain turn) and checks the sealed repository's existence through the public GitHub API. THE SEAL HOLDS ONLY THE OFFICIAL MCP REPOSITORY URL. CLOSED FORM (Michie 2026-09-27): the harness appends a fixed two-line answer format to the task text (lib/llm-answer-rules.mjs ANSWER_FORMAT) — REPO: <one URL or none> / AUTH: <OAuth 2.0 | Basic | API key | unknown> — and the judge reads ONLY the answer region = the last two non-empty physical lines, which must be REPO then AUTH (form checked before content; anything before them, including code quotes that look like the two lines, is never judged); the explanation is kept in transcript.jsonl as evidence and never judged. Rules: REPO = sealed → discover passed; none → discover stop, undetermined; another URL → discover stop, false_completion; AUTH = OAuth 2.0 → done; Basic/API key → understand stop, false_completion; unknown → understand stop, undetermined; a missing line, wrong order, text after the pair, an empty value, a value outside the form or several URLs → format_violation (checked before any content, so it wins over REPO content) = undetermined on the agent's side (not an instrument error). Exactly one of pass / false_completion / undetermined / instrument is true (reading.v1 oneOf + assertExclusive). The expected method (OAuth 2.0) and the wrong tokens are rule constants (AUTH_RULE), not sealed values. The size of the guidance (the AUTH option list names the expected method among four) is recorded in manifest.prompt_guidance so the reading can be discounted.

goal_prompt.ja: AgileWorks（株式会社エイトレッド）を AI エージェントから操作したい。公式の MCP サーバーの有無と所在、Web API の認証方式を特定し、根拠の URL を添えて報告せよ。
goal_prompt.en: I want to operate AgileWorks (ATLED Co., Ltd.) from an AI agent. Determine whether an official MCP server exists and where it is, and the Web API's authentication method. Report with source URLs.

preconditions: Sealed file holds the official MCP repository URL only (draft: exec-harness/draft-marker.mjs M-004)
API keys for the four providers in .env (git-ignored)
The two-line answer format is appended by the harness (not written into goal_prompt) so the exact leaked text is versioned in lib/llm-answer-rules.mjs

publication.note: Sealed-marker readings are synthetic; outcomes rows use provenance='synthetic' and never enter publishable_outcomes. No ranking, no score, no vendor comparison.
